protocol.aggregation: Equal tape mean inside scenario, equal scenario mean, then equal seed mean; report individual seeds, task metrics and transition weighted results. Development screening does not establish new-Test statistical significance.

data.history: last four pre graphs, previous executed actions, observed past time gaps; current action separate
data.target: G_commit latent; supervised reference uses commit-state delta/reward/cost
data.test: Never loaded or generated by this development runner

protocol.failure_policy: Preserve all runs and reject progression if any mandatory gate fails. No extra seeds/updates or Test-driven selection. Errors/timeouts preserve partial evidence and are not scientific gate failure.
protocol.mask: Whole random node type per sample, remove its features, all dynamic/event-eligible fields on other types, and all relation attributes in both directions; no mask/assignment one-hot shortcut
protocol.migration: User requested server-only execution. Previous CPU attempt interrupted, archived and excluded from CUDA matrix; no score-based selection.
protocol.next: If all development gates pass, freeze independent confirmation data/budget and validate before J02C/P01; otherwise seal negative result and stop this candidate branch. GPPO-History remains conditional and unexecuted.
protocol.purpose: Fixed-budget development screening before any confirmation Test or policy extension

readout.labels: All downstream task readouts use identical Train labels; pure JEPA encoder/predictor training itself does not use task labels
references: random encoder and predictor with same readout

server_preflight.prior_cpu_attempt: incomplete; preserve separately, do not mix hardware scores

protocol.threshold_rationale: Prospective development screen, not statistical proof: 5% minimum improvement avoids pursuing numerically trivial changes; at most 10% loss to supervised/raw task references bounds practical degradation. Latent std/rank detect collapse. Branch regret tests candidate-action consequences using immediate reward, not long-term optimality. These thresholds are fixed before any candidate Validation score is computed and are not inherited J01 gates.

training.variance_regularization: 0.1 standard deviation floor across batch per node channel, coefficient 1
